LanguageData.BOR_Sunlight.label: sunlight
LanguageData.BOR_Sunlight.description:
A form of Sunlite, the Sunweave-based drug, improved by the introduction of Quasar Alloy Chunks (sold separately) which are ground into a powder and mixed heartily with the original drug.
The Quasar dust added to Sunlight does not harbor an addiction risk, but the addictive chemicals in base Sunlite still linger within the drug albeit to a lesser extent.
